algorithm_contract.numeric_rule: Every F32 multiply/add/subtract is one R32 round-to-nearest-ties-to-even point; do not fuse, regroup, or change loop order. Preserve signed zero and gradual underflow. Nonfinite intermediate or output is fatal per N00.2.
algorithm_contract.analysis_input: One lane supplies x[0..63], H[0..8][0..63] from that lane's before analysis history, qwin_synthesis_640[0..639], rotation[0..63] as 64 complex pairs, and the validated fixed-64 FFT provider.
algorithm_contract.analysis_fold: For k=0..63: e=(H[6,k]*P[128+k])+(H[8,k]*P[k]); then e+=(H[4,k]*P[256+k]); e+=(H[2,k]*P[384+k]); e+=(H[0,k]*P[512+k]); o=(H[5,k]*P[192+k])+(H[7,k]*P[64+k]); then o+=(H[3,k]*P[320+k]); o+=(H[1,k]*P[448+k]); o+=(x[k]*P[576+k]); store fold[126-2*k]=o and fold[127-2*k]=e. Each term follows the displayed left-to-right R32 order.
algorithm_contract.analysis_next_history: After producing all 128 fold scalars, next H=[x,H[0],H[1],...,H[7]] by raw F32 bits; advance once per 64-sample slot, not once per callback.
algorithm_contract.analysis_rotation: For folded complex (r,i) and rotation (a,b): rotated.real=(i*a)-(r*b); rotated.imag=(i*b)+(r*a), with each operation independently R32. Rotation source is math provider rotation_u32, not FFT stage roots.
algorithm_contract.analysis_fft_and_reorder: Prepare R32(v/64) for all 128 rotated F32 scalars before the first FFT butterfly. Call the fixed 64-complex FFT with no mode parameter. For p=0..31 and FFT output U as U32: out[4p]=U[2p]; out[4p+1]=U[2p+1] XOR 0x80000000; out[4p+2]=U[126-2p]; out[4p+3]=U[127-2p]. XOR is bitwise and must preserve signed-zero/subnormal bits.
algorithm_contract.receiver_mode1_delay_and_fir: For a supplied surround lane's 24-slot analysis X[24][128], join old D[10][128]||X and use the first 24 slots as delay output. In mode=1 each delayed complex band (r,i) becomes (i XOR 0x80000000,r); next D is the last 10 slots of the unrotated X. Band0 FIR reads current X band0, not the delay output: A=old 20 complex samples||X band0. For s=0..23, initialize ar=ai=+0 and for t=0..20 ascending let (x,y)=A[s+t], ar=(ar+(R[t]*x))-(I[t]*y), ai=(ai+(R[t]*y))+(I[t]*x). Replace band0 with (2*ar,2*ai); other 63 bands retain the delay output. Next FIR history is the last 20 complex samples of A.
algorithm_contract.synthesis_preformat: For each processed band slot, with reordered input U as U32, p=0..31: V[2p]=U[4p]; V[2p+1]=U[4p+1] XOR 0x80000000; V[126-2p]=U[4p+2]; V[127-2p]=U[4p+3]. This is the inverse analysis bit permutation.
algorithm_contract.synthesis_fft_and_postmodulation: Call the same fixed 64-complex negative-exponent FFT on V without 1/64 input scaling. For each output (r,i) and rotation (a,b): real=((r*b)+(i*a))*2; imag=((i*b)-(r*a))*2. Every multiplication, addition, subtraction, and factor-of-two multiplication has a separate R32 point.
algorithm_contract.synthesis_polyphase: For k=0..63 let poly_group=floor(k/4), lane=k mod 4, h=36*poly_group+lane; all right-hand H references use the old 576-word snapshot. v=(P[k]*r[k])+H[h]; output[k]=v+v. For j=0..7, c=i[k] when (j+1) is odd, otherwise r[k]; nextH[h+4*j]=(P[64*(j+1)+k]*c)+H[h+4*(j+1)]. Then nextH[h+32]=P[576+k]*i[k]. This produces 64 samples per slot and advances one synthesis history per processed slot.

pipeline_order.owner: F04R producer, called once by F04C for this successful receiver callback
pipeline_order.operation: Run each of 16 rows independently over 1536 samples in six 256-sample chunks; use alpha, beta, strict tiny threshold, and fixed scale 0.25; scalar carries across chunks and callbacks.

pipeline_order.stage: F04R.4 target installation and row/lane accumulation
pipeline_order.operation: Install only supplied same-g target values; clear six 1536-sample accumulators; process 48 ordered 32-sample blocks, row0..15 then lane0..5, using the per-row/per-lane ramp state.

pipeline_order.stage: F04R.5 transform delay, PG01 blend, first ring
pipeline_order.operation: Per lane emit the prior 32-sample delay, save the current accumulator block, perform the ordered two-ended N32 blend and fixed 256 scaling, then clamp/write/read/advance the independent 225-sample first ring.
Process only lane3 as six ordered 256-sample chunks through four coefficient sections in pair order; carry the four section states across chunks and callbacks; do not add a tiny-history clear.
pipeline_order.input_output: pre-LFE-filter candidate lane3 -> filtered lane3; lanes0/1/2/4/5 pass unchanged; combine as s09_input[6][1536].

pipeline_order.stage: F04Q receiver analysis and mode=1 output
pipeline_order.owner: F04R producer through the separate F04Q stage
pipeline_order.operation: Analyze lanes0/1/2/4/5 as 24 ordered 64-sample slots; only lanes4/5 apply ten-slot delay, mode=1 phase transform, 21-tap band0 FIR and synthesis. Lane3 bypasses QMF.
pipeline_order.input_output: s09_input[6][1536] with lane3 already post-filtered -> QMF analysis histories and updated Ls/Rs PCM scratch.

pipeline_order.stage: F04R.7 temporal0 then temporal1 then temporal2
pipeline_order.operation: Run three independent double-span exchanges in this order: temporal0 span1217 lanes[0,1,2], temporal1 span63 lanes[0,1,2,4,5], temporal2 span900 lane[3].
pipeline_order.input_output: QMF/post-filter scratch -> post-temporal0..2 scratch for descriptor selection.

pipeline_order.owner: F04D substage, executed within the F04C-owned callback
pipeline_order.operation: Select from post-temporal0..2 scratch and descriptor before-state; peak reads lanes[0,1,2,4,5], excluding LFE lane3. This phase returns a same-callback selection/proposal, not final_six.
pipeline_order.input_output: post-temporal0..2 scratch -> selected index/control proposal carried across temporal3.

pipeline_order.operation: Run the fourth exchange over all six lanes with span256 after descriptor selection; never combine temporal0..3 into one buffer.

pipeline_order.owner: F04D substage, executed within the F04C-owned callback
pipeline_order.operation: Apply the selected target to all six lanes after temporal3; the first 256 samples share the callback ramp and samples256..1535 use target gain.

pipeline_order.stage: F04R.8 post-S09 delay and half scale
pipeline_order.operation: Per lane prepend the prior 32-sample tail to current[0..1504], save current[1504..1536] as the next tail, then multiply each sample by 0.5.
pipeline_order.input_output: descriptor-gained six-lane output -> delayed and half-scaled six-lane output.

pipeline_order.owner: F04R producer; output remains subordinate to the enclosing F04C callback
pipeline_order.operation: Apply the independent second ring with the same clamp, write-before-read, and 225-slot cursor rules as the first ring.

delay_and_ring_rules.transform_delay_and_blend: For each lane and 32-sample block, emit the old 32-sample delay and replace it with the current accumulator block. With W=receiver_blend32 and a5=a6=2^-8, evaluate left=(x[j]*a5)*W[31-j], right=(x[j]*a6)*W[j], output=(left+right)*256 using the specified separate F32 operations; do not merge complementary-window products.
delay_and_ring_rules.first_ring: Clamp each finite input sample to [-1,1], write at write_index, read at read_index, then advance both independent cursors by one modulo 225. Cold write=224/read=0 yields a 224-sample actual delay; this is a distinct ring owner.
delay_and_ring_rules.temporal_exchange: index_28 is the semantic read cursor; index_32 is the semantic write cursor; stride_bytes is 4. Both cursors use the inclusive range 0..2*span; 2*span is valid and is not eagerly reduced. For N=1536, count=min(span,N), write_first=min(count,2*span-write), read_first=min(count,2*span-read); write the last count input samples with one wrap before reading count outputs from the updated buffer with one wrap, then append input[0:N-count]. next_write=write+count if count==write_first else count-write_first; next_read=read+count if count==read_first else count-read_first.
delay_and_ring_rules.post_s09_delay_and_half: After the descriptor ramp, per lane output old_delay[32] followed by current[0..1504]; set next_delay=current[1504..1536], then multiply the complete 1536-sample lane by 0.5.
delay_and_ring_rules.second_ring: Apply a second independent ring after half scale, with the same clamp/write-before-read/cursor-modulo-225 rule as the first ring; cold write=224/read=0. Do not alias the two ring states.
